## Overview

- [home](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/home.md): <HomePage> <HomeHero eyebrow="Claude Platform" title="Start building with Claude" subtitle="Everything you need to integrate Claude into your applications.
- [Prerequisites](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/get-started.md): Export your API key as an environment variable. The cURL command below reads it from `$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.
- [Recommended path for new developers](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/intro.md): Follow these steps to go from zero to a working Claude integration.
- [Choose a key type](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/get-api-key.md): When you create a key, you choose its type, which determines what the key can do, where it works, and when it stops working.
- [API usage primer for Claude](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/claude_api_primer.md): > This guide is designed to give Claude the basics of using the Claude API.
